name: Expo Booth Booking
author: brandjaws

sections.description:
• Create an Expo Map (custom post type), upload a floor map image.
  • Define booths as JSON with id, x/y (percent), type, product_id, price.
  • Embed via [brandjaws_ebb_booth_map id=”123″] or Elementor widget.
  • Clicking a booth adds the linked product to WooCommerce cart via AJAX and temporarily reserves it.

Notes

  • Ensure each booth links to a unique WooCommerce product with stock qty = 1 for simple booking.
  • Reservations use transients (~10 minutes). Completing order should rely on product stock for final booking.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the expo-booth-booking folder to /wp-content/plugins/.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen.
  3. Create an Expo Map: WP Admin > Expo Maps.
  4. Add a page with the shortcode or Elementor widget.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin create any external requests or track users?

No.
